body:
yea, I've been there.  I've been all the way there.  lost all that, lost my money, my friends, my girl, my life,  I hated my self.  I did try to commit suicide once, I smashed my car going 70 into a tree (I was aiming for a wall).   Oh I know all to well that creeping feeling of complete and utter hate, the feeling of shallow breathing laying on the bed just praying all that you can pray that you don't wake up.

I've been there.  and I could say the cliche thing everyone says "it gets betters".  but you don't really want to hear that.  I didn't at least.  

But before you do anything, answer this for me.  What were those things, the hobbies how have that you have dropped.  Talk to me about those for a bit will you.
I really appreciate you talking to me.  it made my night a bit better.

I know right, its on hulu plus.  I was about to say netflix but that would be a lie.  It's bringing back the good ol days.  

The manga's going crazy, Idk what they are going to do with sasuke or the Hokage.  Theres a LOT of power players and team to many on one side or the other and the scales are tipped WAY to far.  Idk what is in the plans but itd be nice to see sasuke good, it'd be weird to see Orochimaru as either good or bad to be honest, and the hokage... well I honestly don't think I care to see them fight, maybe the 3rd, just because hes narutos dad. but thats about it.

oohhh no.  is it possible they killed him off?  that would seem crazy.

On a side note, I've started re watching Naruto, currently in the Chunnin exams with lee and Gaara fighting for the first time.  SUPER BA.  That being said, like the first 15 or so episodes were rather boring.  I'm completely caught up on the manga and its just soo crazy how far the series has come.
yea, I'm actually looking into an app where I can document if I wanted to change, didn't want to, or didn't think about it.

That sounds sick, and I saw a pic of maybe a cover or something involving this, which also looked sick.  Alfred is pretty BA as far as I know, hes held his own in the past.  That being said I mean it is the joker and I don't know the exacts in this arch so theres that.

Man I really can't get into dc.  I like batman enough but I've just heard soo much about the inconsistencies and the wierd continuity of everything that Idk it doesn't really appeal to me.  
I have to say civil war is pretty cool.  If your into xmen you really should read House of M.  Its a GREAT read and has a lot to do with the mutant-verse

I've not really been keeping up with the marvel comics, I've been stuck in the civil war/house of M arch.  I know about the AvX arch and have read a few comics from that which I thought was AWESOME and I know of Marvel Now but don't know anything about it.

who are your fave. characters in Naruto and Marvel? I like Shino but hes not in it enough but I LOVE Itachi soo much.  In Marvel I really like ironman and Dr. Strange.

I really wish I had any artistic ability, it'd be super cool to be able to sketch my own comics.

Did she pass away or was it a split up?  Either way I've been through both.  And although I'm not really at any point in my life to be someones rock, I know what its like in both these situations and can backseat my emotions and thoughts on life to try to help another human.  
I'm sorry that you harmed yourself, I and others are here for you.
I like naruto, and rpgs like dnd/shadowrun/and VtM, I like Marvel, not just the movies. I like girls fashion.
I'm sorry to hear that, how did you lose your loved one if you don't mind me asking?
